messages:
Anna (Partnerships): Heads up — we're prepping AWS/GCP/Azure listings for the release. Need final metadata mapping + rollback plan. Can legal confirm SKU mapping and EULA localization?
Matt (Cloud Eng): I'm on the SKU mapping. attaching draft mapping below. Will also add AMI IDs for AWS.
Matt (Cloud Eng): ```
{
  "sku": "redwood-inference-small",
  "plans": ["starter", "pro"],
  "region_overrides": {"eu": "redwood-inference-eu"}
}
```
Priya (Product): Need to confirm packaging names — marketplace display name must match marketing. Linked doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/marketplace-display-names
Jorge (Legal): @Anna @Priya I can sign off on EULA localization but need the privacy addendum for EU. Send the latest doc. Also note tax text for EU market is required.
Anna (Partnerships): Uploading privacy addendum now.
Anna (Partnerships): https://redwood.internal/attachments/privacy-addendum-v3.pdf :eyes:
Ben (Sales): FYI, Azure listing needs entitlement mapping for CSP — I've started a spreadsheet: https://tiny.redwood/s/csp-entitlements
Legal-bot: Reminder: marketplace contracts require 30-day review SLA.
Matt (Cloud Eng): For rollback — plan: snap AMI + keep previous container image in registry; infra ci job: `marketplace/rollback.sh`
Matt (Cloud Eng): ```bash
# run from infra repo
./deploy/marketplace/rollback.sh --region eu --sku redwood-inference-small
```
Priya (Product): Can we add a canary publish window 2 hours before full go? reduces risk.
Anna (Partnerships): Yes. Let's schedule canary + legal sign-off. Action items:
- Jorge: EULA & tax text (due 1971234620)
- Matt: AMI + rollback script validation (due 1971234700)
- Priya: display name final + marketing assets (due 1971234680)
- Ben: CSP entitlement mapping (due 1971234680)
Anna (Partnerships): ping me when each is done :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: marketplace publish started (canary) — 1971234725
Ben (Sales): Canary looks good from CSP side :thumbsup:
Jorge (Legal): EULA updated and uploaded.
Anna (Partnerships): thanks all — closing thread once deploy completes.
